summary: ServiceCode represents service codes and manages their retrieval and localization.
purpose: To manage service codes including retrieval, localization, and organization.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for a service code.

fields.name: CodeCategoryID
fields.description: Identifier for category to which service code belongs.

fields.name: ShortName
fields.description: Short name or code for the service.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Order of service code for sorting purposes.

business_rules.description: Service codes are retrieved using specific stored procedures depending on session and context.

system_behavior.description: Service codes can be retrieved by different criteria including courseID and timetableID.
